newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 447,000 MT were 55 percent below the week earlier and 27 percent below the 4-week average. Major increases reported for South Korea (215,500 MT, 54,500 in new sales and 160,900 in destination changes) Mexico (113,300 MT), Egypt (80,000 MT, includes 600 in new sales and 79,400 in destination changes), Taiwan (66,100 MT), and Syria (63,000 MT) were partially offset by decreases for unknown destinations (226,400 MT) and Poland (33,400 MT).

Exports of 979,200 MT were 14 percent over the prior week, but 22 percent less than the 4-week average. The primary recipients were Japan (308,300), South Korea (163,000), Egypt (80,000), Taiwan (73,100), and Chile (40,000).
